During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the [[Ghost cell]] made their '''base of operations''' in a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|Village]]. Its location was secret, all new recruits brought in had no idea of is exact location. The supplies were delivered to the village by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] called [[Milosh Varta|Dragon Eyes]] operating in [[Mos Ila]].
